page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m1.large is an entry-tier virtual server operating on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC processor running at a base clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance configuration includes 2 dedicated vCPUs and 2.0 GB of system memory, providing a 1:1 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 1.0 GB per core. The server does not include GPU acceleration hardware.

Network connectivity features a baseline throughput of 1 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with the instance. The configuration does not include local disk storage, meaning persistent operating system volumes and application data require network-attached storage resources.

With a compact memory allocation paired with dedicated compute cores, the instance provides an efficient profile for low-footprint compute services that do not demand extensive RAM. Primary operational tradeoffs include the absence of onboard disks and strict memory ceilings, positioning this server for microservices, proxy layers, lightweight web serving, and automation tasks.
